description: Rebates for New and Used Electric Vehicles in Nova Scotia is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. The province is strengthening its commitment to address climate change and grow the economy with its new Electric Vehicle Rebate program. The rebate program gives Nova Scotians of varying income levels to take part in the shift to clean transportation. The Clean Foundation administers the point-of-sale rebate program through auto dealers and bicycle retailers. Coverage: Government of Nova Scotia.
